description: 26.2 Fabric Minecraft Mod for Hypixel Skyblock that automatically generates an optimized coal route to mine in the Crystal Hollows, based on the layout of the lobby and which veins have been mined already.

mods.name: CoalRouteGenerator
mods.description: Scans the Crystal Hollows on arrival and suggests a high-value coal route. Display-only: it renders waypoints and never moves or mines for you.
